item.coloph: phyis su gshen rab mi bo sku bltams nas shing byi sum brgya dang dgu pa'i sa mo glang gi bzhin ras ngoms dus / khro chen kun dga' nor bus spar du bsgrun [~bskrun] pa'i dag ther gza' khur dang / dkar chag brgyud rim bcas pa bdag smon rgyal sangs rgyas rin chen dpal bzang gis / hor zla drug pa'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes bzang por bkod
item.note: a 2-folio appended text, untitled, has an interesting colophon. it was composed by smon-rgyal sangs-rgyas rin-chen dpal-bzang as lineage prayer and table of contents to the present cycle as it was printed by khro-chen kun-dga' nor-bu in an earth sheep year (1769). smon-rgyal sangs-rin (i.e. sangs-rgyas rin-chen) is known to be among the several names of kun-grol grags-pa himself.

item.coloph: gzhi ka dag nyi ma legs shar bas/ lam g.yung drung rin chen 'bar ba'i gling / 'bras ge sar bstan pa'i 'dab ma bzhad/ dus yol med rgyal ba'i phyag rgyas mnan//
